reason: My guests already find me on Google Maps, Glovo and Wolt, and the menu is there. I don't see who would visit a separate website, so 25 a month is money for something nobody asked me for.
objection: It's one more thing to keep updated next to Glovo, Wolt and Google. If I change the price here, I still have to change it on the tablet and in the apps, so it doesn't actually save me work.
would_change_my_mind: If the same WhatsApp message also updated my menu and prices on Glovo, Wolt and Google Maps at once, then I'd pay, because that is the work that eats my time.
